title: Alvin R. Dyer
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a child; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young aman
Married May Elizabeth Jackson, Salt Lake Temple; 1926; two children
Ordained an Apostle (but not a member of the Twelve) 1967
Resumed position as Assistant to the Twelve 1970-1976
Sustained a member of the First Quorum of the Seventy 1976-1977
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
